(?fsm:domain_storage_report__domain_aux

  (+types
    (type packet_t (record (flag bit) (data (bits 7))))
  )

  (+system
    (clock aux_clk)
    (sreset aux_reset)
  )

  (+interface
    (input aux_start)
    (output aux_done)
    (internal aux_word)
  )

  (+size
    (aux_start 1)
    (aux_done 1)
    (aux_word 12 (reset 7))
    (can_accept 1)
  )

  (other_idle_0
    (= (can_accept 1))
    (<aux_start
      (-> other_set_1)
    )
  )

  (other_set_1
    (<- (aux_word 7))
    (-> other_done_2)
  )

  (other_done_2
    (<1 (aux_done> 1))
    (-> other_idle_0)
  )

)
scheduled_files.domain_storage_report__domain_core.fsm:
(?fsm:domain_storage_report__domain_core

  (+types
    (type packet_t (record (flag bit) (data (bits 7))))
  )

  (+system
    (clock clk)
    (areset rst_n)
  )

  (+interface
    (input start)
    (input ack)
    (output done)
    (internal core_word)
    (internal core_record)
    (internal bytes_0)
    (internal bytes_1)
  )

  (+size
    (start 1)
    (ack 1)
    (done 1)
    (core_word 8 (reset 1))
    (core_record packet_t (reset 3))
    (bytes_0 8)
    (bytes_1 8)
    (can_accept 1)
    (last_error 1)
    (main_wd 3)
  )

  (main_idle_0
    (= (can_accept 1))
    (<= (main_wd (- 5 1)))
    (<start
      (-> main_set_1)
    )
  )

  (main_set_1
    (<- (core_word 1))
    (-> main_await_2)
  )

  (main_await_2
    (<ack
      (-> main_done_3)
    )
    (?main_wd
      (=0 (-> main_timeout))
      (>0 (-- main_wd))
    )
  )

  (main_done_3
    (<1 (done> 1))
    (-> main_idle_0)
  )

  (main_timeout
    (<1 (done> 1))
    (<- (last_error 1))
    (-> main_idle_0)
  )

)
